title: TypeScript provider refusal frame
description: The frame the provider writes when it refuses a query, mirrored from the frame builder. This document fills the event role for this operation.

sourceContract.drift: refusalFrame is the authority for this frame; this document is its admitted mirror, so a change to those lines requires a change here. A refusal carries the frame version 1, the engine name, the query in hand or null, and a validationRefusal error whose condition is the rule that refused and whose limits are the limits it names (:295-299); request member values, paths and expressions never appear in a refusal, and provider stderr carries no request content either (:8-10).
sourceContract.roleNote: This operation emits no event stream: the provider writes exactly one frame per query and exits, and the exit status separates a result from a refusal and from a failure (provider.mjs:1-15, :6-15). The event role therefore names this frame, the module's other emitted frame, and no streaming event shape is claimed.
sourceContract.identityNote: no $id is set: the admitted identity is a hole for package admission to fill, named by the inventory it admits.

crossFieldRules.detail: the condition is fixed text naming the rule that refused; no request member value, path or expression appears in it
exit status 0 is one result frame, 2 is one refusal frame and 1 is a provider failure on stderr with no result published
